Definition: a stall for cattle (from their resting there)
BiblicalUsage: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines, the labour of the olive shall fail, and there shall be no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the empty stall is the test of faith, and Habakkuk passes it singing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
